name: Sylas
title: the Unshackled

Q.name: Chain Lash
Q.description: Sylas lashes his chains out, dealing 40/60/80/100/120 + 0.4×AP magic damage and Slowing by 0.15/0.2/0.25/0.3/0.35 for 1.5 seconds. The place where the chains intersect explodes, dealing a further 60/115/170/225/280 + 0.8×AP magic damage.
Q.summary: Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies. After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.

W.name: Kingslayer
W.description: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing 75/110/145/180/215 + 0.6×AP magic damage. Against champions, Sylas restores between 20/40/60/80/100 + 0.3×AP + 0.05×bonus max HP and (20/40/60/80/100 + 0.3×AP + 0.05×bonus max HP) × 2 Health based on his missing Health (max healing at or below 40% Health).
W.summary: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.

E.name: Abscond / Abduct
E.description: Sylas quickly dashes, and prepares a Recast for 3.5 seconds. Recast: Sylas throws his chains, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, dealing 80/130/180/230/280 + 0.8×AP magic damage, and Knocking Up for 0.5 seconds.
E.summary: Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.

R.name: Hijack
R.description: Sylas hijacks an enemy champion, allowing him to cast a copy of their ultimate Ability, based on his Ultimate level and using his stats. Hijacking an enemy places a Cooldown on them for (? × 200)% (modified by Sylas' Ability Haste) of the enemy's ultimate's Cooldown, with a minimum of 40 seconds, during which time Sylas cannot hijack them again.
R.summary: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.

Passive.name: Petricite Burst
Passive.description: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst. Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. While Sylas has a charge of Petricite Burst, he gains attack speed.
Passive.summary: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst. Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. While Sylas has a charge of Petricite Burst, he gains attack speed.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Sylas is a mage skirmisher who chains people with his flails, heals through Kingslayer and steals enemy ultimates with Hijack. He plays mid or jungle and wins long fights by weaving abilities and empowered auto attacks.
strengths: Hijack lets him use the enemy's ultimate, which can win teamfights.
Kingslayer heals more the lower his HP is, so he wins close fights.
Abscond/Abduct gives a dash and a knock-up to engage or escape.
Petricite Burst passive gives extra damage after each ability.
Strong skirmisher: his combos and heal let him win long fights.
weaknesses: Short range: he must get close to deal damage.
Weak early before he has items and his ultimate.
His Abduct chain is a skillshot; missing it leaves him exposed.
Can be kited by long-range champions.
Depends on enemy ultimates; weak ultimates reduce his value.

curve.lvl1: okay – a Q and passive attack trade is fine, but he cannot all-in
curve.lvl2: okay – E gives a dash and knock-up; better trades
curve.lvl3: good – full combo (E, Q, W) with heal for strong trades
curve.lvl6: strong – Hijack depends on the enemy team's ultimates
curve.items: strong – first item: Everfrost, Hextech Rocketbelt or Riftmaker add damage and engage; Zhonya's Hourglass for safety
curve.late: good – stays strong in teamfights thanks to stolen ultimates

profile.curveNote: Sylas wants all three basic abilities to fight, and becomes much stronger with Hijack. He is weaker early before his first item.
profile.waveClear: Good: Q and passive clear waves well.
profile.sustain: High: Kingslayer heals him more at low HP.
profile.mobility: Good: E dash and Abduct follow-up.

keyAbilities.trading: E (Abscond/Abduct) to engage, then Q and W
keyAbilities.engage: R (Hijack) to use an enemy ultimate
keyAbilities.answers: None. Sylas has no spell shield or dodge.

Passive.notes: Petricite Burst: after each ability his next attack deals extra damage to enemies around.

Q.notes: Chain Lash: the chains cross and explode, slowing. Damage is higher where they cross.

W.notes: Kingslayer: a point-and-click lunge that heals more the lower his HP is.

E.answer: Dodge sideways, or block it with a projectile block.
E.notes: Abscond/Abduct: dash, then recast throws a chain that knocks up the first enemy hit and pulls Sylas to them.

R.notes: Hijack: steals the enemy's ultimate for him to use. The stolen ultimate works as it would for the enemy.

profile.windowAgainst: Sylas's window is when his E is on cooldown or after he has missed Abduct: punish him while he has no dash.
checks: Does Sylas use Kingslayer at low HP for the bigger heal?
Does Sylas steal ultimates that can change teamfights?
